No human signature is required for any of this (owner ruling 2026-10-27, retired V-10).

open_owner_decisions.item: expected_ids declares 32 items (29 official + 3 M15-01 addendum) while the official contract count is undecided between 29 and 39
open_owner_decisions.why_it_blocks: G14b/G14c make the declaration binding, so the addendum items can be kept only by owner ratification; dropping them instead leaves no Arena-evidenced verifying item and the gate stays NOT VERIFIED by V-16. No number may be chosen by the chats: the owner picks 29 (drop A/B/C), 32 (ratify the addendum) or 39 (extend the contract).

open_owner_decisions.item: Human approval of the verification registry
open_owner_decisions.why_it_blocks: No longer blocks anything. The owner ruled that direct oversight of the project continues and that a per-registry human signature is not a condition for passing the Strict Verification Gate; V-10 was removed from the gate, from the schema and from this builder, and the retirement is pinned by controls in the negative fixtures and by property P3 of the acceptance suite. The registry remains NOT VERIFIED for unrelated, honest reasons: 29 legacy items are UNKNOWN (V-15) and nothing was promoted to satisfy a gate.

open_owner_decisions.item: strict-verification.yml runs on push to arena/** while V-06 push mode requires HEAD to be an ancestor of origin/main
open_owner_decisions.why_it_blocks: A branch push can never satisfy V-06. Changing the trigger drops CI coverage; changing V-06 alters a security contract. Both are owner decisions.

open_owner_decisions.item: Landing strategy for the registry-only metadata commit
open_owner_decisions.why_it_blocks: Only a single-parent landing (fast-forward) preserves the two-phase binding; a merge commit or a squash invalidates V-02/G9 by construction and the registry must be rebuilt after landing.
